title: app-services-v1 service manifest (SVC-1)
description: Normative shape for the `service` and `state` objects a service-bearing pak.json carries. See contracts.md#svc-1--service-manifest. This schema checks static shape only; runtime rules (foreground-must-stay behavior, Primary-root install target, symlink-escape detection, executable-bit checks) are enforced by Jawaka at load/validate time and are exercised by the fixtures in manifests/, not by this schema alone.

id.description: Top-level stable reverse-DNS package id. Must equal service.id.

schema.description: Exactly 1. Unknown values make the service unavailable.

id.description: Stable, globally unique, reverse-DNS. Duplicates make both services unavailable.

path.description: Relative, confined to the pak, a regular executable file. Absolute paths, '..', and symlinks escaping the pak fail validation.

items.description: Shape-only upper bound in Unicode code points (this JSON Schema keyword has no byte-count form). The real SVC-1 limit is 256 UTF-8 BYTES per argument -- a multibyte string can be under this code-point maxLength and still be over that byte limit. The byte-accurate check is business logic (validate_manifest() in scripts/validate_fixtures.py), not this schema.

default_enabled.description: Must be false for schema: 1. Enablement is always a user act.

stop_grace_ms.description: Absent means 5000. Negative values are rejected. Values above 15000 are clamped to 15000 and logged (clamping happens after schema validation, not encoded here).
